name: Emma Turner
education: B.S. in Computer Science, Northeastern University
summary: Staff Engineer with 6 years of experience designing distributed systems for high-traffic platforms. Strong on system design and horizontal scalability with Python-based services, and actively building production experience in Go and PostgreSQL-backed storage.
strengths: Solid distributed systems and scalability design for high-concurrency services
Strong Python backend engineering with Redis and Kafka in production
Leads design reviews and cross-team technical discussions
gaps: No production Go experience; primary language is Python

resumeText: Emma Turner is a Staff Engineer at Fathom Platforms with six years of experience designing distributed systems for high-traffic platforms. She works across system design, scalability, and event streaming with Kafka and Redis. Her core expertise is Python; she is expanding into Go and PostgreSQL as her team standardizes on them.
